name: Desperado Product Inquiry Buttons for WooCommerce
author: desperadohouse

sections.description:
Desperado Product Inquiry Buttons for WooCommerce adds customizable contact buttons to your product pages, allowing customers to easily inquire about products via their preferred messaging platform.

Features

  • Add WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram, SMS and Email buttons
  • Customizable button colors and text
  • Custom message templates with product variables
  • Enable/disable individual buttons
  • Easy setup and configuration
  • Mobile-responsive design

Supported Platforms

  • WhatsApp
  • Viber
  • Telegram
  • SMS
  • Email
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/desperado-product-inquiry-buttons directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under WooCommerce > Settings > Product Inquiry Buttons.
  4. The inquiry buttons will automatically appear on your product pages.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the button colors?

Yes, you can customize each button’s color in the plugin settings.

Can I change the inquiry message?

Yes, you can customize the message template using the following variables: {product_name}, {product_sku}, {product_url}

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.
